sources.summary: Located on Nguyen Phan Vinh Street in Tan Thanh, Hoi An, the villa occupies a 360-square-meter coastal site near the transition zone of the city's heritage core. The TH Villa Hoi An transforms the strict planning controls of Hoi An's coastal edge into a flexible retreat where family life, hospitality, and the surrounding seascape can coexist.
